description: Source code for GPIO driver implementation for DesignWare GPIO in Zephyr RTOS, including register access, configuration, interrupt handling, and device initialization.

methods.name: dw_read
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a register at base address plus offset, using IO access or MMIO depending on configuration.

methods.name: dw_write
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a register at base address plus offset, using IO access or MMIO depending on configuration.

methods.name: dw_set_bit
methods.description: Sets or clears a specific bit in a register at base address plus offset.

methods.name: dw_base_to_block_base
methods.description: Calculates the block base address from a given base address.

methods.name: dw_derive_port_from_base
methods.description: Derives port number from base address.

methods.name: dw_interrupt_support
methods.description: Checks if the GPIO configuration supports interrupts.

methods.name: dw_get_ext_port
methods.description: Returns external port identifier based on base address.

methods.name: dw_get_data_port
methods.description: Returns data port identifier based on base address.

methods.name: dw_get_dir_port
methods.description: Returns direction port identifier based on base address.

methods.name: gpio_dw_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt for a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: dw_pin_config
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin direction and initial state.

methods.name: gpio_dw_config
methods.description: Configures GPIO pin with specified flags, including input/output and debounce.

methods.name: gpio_dw_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw port value.

methods.name: gpio_dw_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits with masking.

methods.name: gpio_dw_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits in port.

methods.name: gpio_dw_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits in port.

methods.name: gpio_dw_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits in port.

methods.name: gpio_dw_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages GPIO callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_dw_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO, handles interrupt and fires callbacks.

methods.name: gpio_dw_initialize
methods.description: Initializes GPIO device, sets up interrupts if supported.
